ABOUT.TITLE: About Me
ABOUT.PARAGRAPH1: I’m Fatma Baccari, a passionate computer scientist from Tunisia. I graduated with a Bachelor's degree in Software Engineering and Information Systems from the Faculty of Sciences of Sfax (FSS), University of Sfax. Currently, I am pursuing a Master's in Systems, Networks, and Cloud Computing, where I continue to explore how technology can solve real-world problems and shape the future.
ABOUT.PARAGRAPH2: Driven by curiosity and determination, I see every challenge as an opportunity to innovate and grow. Beyond coding, I value teamwork, adaptability, and lifelong learning — qualities that allow me to combine creativity with precision in everything I do.

PROJECTS.TITLE: Projects & Professional Experience
PROJECTS.DESCRIPTION: Discover my personal projects and professional internships.

INTERNSHIPS.AUTH.TITLE: Authentication Microservices with Keycloak and Kafka
INTERNSHIPS.AUTH.DESCRIPTION: Development of an identity service in a microservices architecture, integrating Keycloak with a custom database and comprehensive API security via NestJS. Implementation of Kafka for asynchronous communication between services and orchestrated deployment with Docker. On the front-end side, creation of a fully customized Angular interface, without using the native Keycloak theme, highlighting user experience and graphic consistency.

INTERNSHIPS.ODOO.TITLE: Odoo ERP Module - Supply Chain
INTERNSHIPS.ODOO.DESCRIPTION: Development of a customized module on Odoo ERP for stock management automation. Data modeling, business workflow development, and integration with the existing inventory module.

WEATHERLY.TITLE: Weatherly - Weather Application
WEATHERLY.DESCRIPTION: Development of a native Android application implementing an MVC architecture with REST API consumption. Integration of the OpenWeatherMap API with JSON data parsing and asynchronous network request management.

DROWSINESS.TITLE: Drowsiness Detection System
DROWSINESS.DESCRIPTION: Implementation of a computer vision system using supervised machine learning. Image processing pipeline including Haar Cascade facial detection, feature extraction, and classification with SVM.
